series.$note: series.observed holds several sources and must not be read as one curve. DS-35: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK), from 1990. DS-02: Asset-level observed emissions, CO₂e GWP100 (Climate TRACE); land use accounted differently from OWID, 2015-2025. Points from an NDC document are that document's own inventory basis. The same year can appear more than once with different values; R3 keeps them side by side and never averages them.

derived.$note: Trend: least-squares slope over 35 observed years (1990-2024) from DS-35, compared against the DS-06-NDC target of 12.894 MtCO₂e by 2030. The two are not necessarily on the same inventory scope, see series.$note. The target tonnage is derived here, not quoted: 20% below DS-35's 2010 value of 16.117 MtCO₂e. The document states the percentage; the level it is applied to comes from DS-35, on DS-35's inventory scope, which is not necessarily the document's.
derived.$reason: the target (12.894 MtCO₂e) is above the latest observed level (11.687 MtCO₂e), so no cut is required today. Carried forward at the observed +0.35 MtCO₂e/yr, 2030 projects 13.8 MtCO₂e, above it.

by_source.scope: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK)
Asset-level observed emissions, CO₂e GWP100 (Climate TRACE); land use accounted differently from OWID
Non-CO₂ greenhouse gases only (CH₄, N₂O, F-gases), AR5 GWP100, excluding LULUCF (EDGAR 2024). CO₂ is omitted for licence reasons, so this is not a national total.

emissions_profile.$note: Headline totals are OWID only. OWID's CO₂ sub-totals are fossil/industrial CO₂ by fuel, not a full sectoral GHG breakdown, and do not sum to total_mtco2e. DS-05's rows are non-CO₂ gases only and are not comparable with the others; that is also why DS-05 is absent from series.observed, where a shorter curve would read as a disagreement rather than a difference of scope. by_source carries each source whole.

verdict.text: Equatorial Guinea pledges a 20% reduction by 2030 against 2010 baseline. A later submission, NDC 2022 Update, was filed on 2022-10-24; it has not been read, so no figure here comes from it. 46 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-35 11.7 MtCO₂e, DS-02 11.6 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. The target is not reached on the observed trend. Both figures are on DS-35's inventory: the document's percentage applied to DS-35's 2010 level, not the document's own. ND-GAIN scores it 35.6 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: 20% reduction in emissions by 2030 compared to 2010 levels, in order to acheive a 50% reduction by 2050 It was classed conditional. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.01°C under SSP1-2.6 to +3.57°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
